uncertified.title: Awaiting certification
uncertified.body: An admin needs to certify your Gedu account before you can start voice rooms or reset Minecraft Education passwords. Both tools appear here as soon as you’re certified.

minecraftPasswordReset.title: Minecraft Education passwords
minecraftPasswordReset.description: Reset the password on a shared Minecraft Education account and read the new one straight off the screen.
minecraftPasswordReset.inputHint: One or many — separate them with spaces, commas or new lines. Bare usernames work, and so do full addresses on {domains}.
minecraftPasswordReset.submit: {count, plural, =0 {Reset passwords} one {Reset 1 password} other {Reset # passwords}}
minecraftPasswordReset.unsupportedDomainEntries: {count, plural, one {Not a Minecraft Education address, so it won’t be sent: {entries}. Use a bare username or an address on {domains}.} other {Not Minecraft Education addresses, so they won’t be sent: {entries}. Use bare usernames or addresses on {domains}.}}
minecraftPasswordReset.tooMany: That’s {count} usernames — reset at most {max} at a time.
minecraftPasswordReset.requestFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
minecraftPasswordReset.mustChangeOnFirstSignIn: Must be changed on first sign-in

errors.invalidUsername: Not a valid entry. Enter a username on its own, or a full Minecraft Education address.
errors.unsupportedDomain: Only accounts on {domains} can be reset.
errors.azureAuth: Couldn’t reach Microsoft. The Azure credentials may have expired — tell an admin.
errors.graphError: Microsoft refused the change (error {status}). Please try again.
